methodology.cloud_operations: Read-only BigQuery metadata, bounded SELECT aggregates, and Dataform REST GETs.
methodology.consistency: Sequential snapshots, not a transactionally consistent cross-service snapshot.
methodology.view_row_counts: BigQuery metadata reports no stored rows for views; zero is not a query result.
methodology.row_sum_limit: Stored-row sums span different grains and are not business-entity or reconciliation totals.
methodology.sensitive_data: No credentials, access tokens, source payloads, personal records, or financial amounts included.

config {
  type: "table",
  schema: "dw_1_silver_visma",
  name: "fact_general_ledger",
  description: "Silver: Flat general ledger transaction lines with historized business unit mapping by accounting date.",
  tags: ["silver", "visma", "fact"]
}

WITH subaccount_dim AS (
  SELECT
    tenant_id,
    subaccount_id,
    subaccount_number,
    segment2 AS segment2_value,
    segment3 AS department_code
  FROM ${ref("dw_1_silver_visma", "dim_subaccount")}
),

business_unit_mapping AS (
  SELECT
    tenant_id,
    source_segment_2_value,
    business_unit_id,
    business_unit_name,
    valid_from,
    COALESCE(valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31') AS valid_to
  FROM ${ref("dw_1_silver_excel", "business_unit_mapping")}
),

customer_document_project_map AS (
  SELECT
    tenantId AS tenant_id,
    referenceNumber AS ref_number,
    ANY_VALUE(JSON_VALUE(project, '$.id')) AS project_id
  FROM ${ref("dw_1_bronze_visma", "visma_customer_documents")}
  WHERE isDeleted IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
    AND JSON_VALUE(project, '$.id') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT JSON_VALUE(project, '$.id')) = 1
),

base AS (
  SELECT
    tenantId AS tenant_id,
    syncedAt AS synced_at,
    organizationName AS organization_name,

    batchNumber AS batch_number,
    refNumber AS ref_number,
    CAST(lineNumber AS STRING) AS line_number,

    COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(account, '$.number'), CAST(account AS STRING)) AS account_cd,
    JSON_VALUE(account, '$.type') AS account_type,
    subaccount AS subaccount_id,
    COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(branch, '$.number'), CAST(branch AS STRING)) AS branch_id,
    COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(ledger, '$.id'), CAST(ledger AS STRING)) AS ledger,
    currency AS currency_id,
    module,

    COALESCE(
      DATE(SAFE_CAST(tranDate AS DATETIME)),
      DATE(SAFE_CAST(tranDate AS TIMESTAMP)),
      SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', period)
    ) AS transaction_date,
    period AS financial_period,

    description,

    debitAmount AS debit_amount,
    creditAmount AS credit_amount,
    begBalance AS beginning_balance,
    endingBalance AS ending_balance,

    currDebitAmount AS debit_amount_currency,
    currCreditAmount AS credit_amount_currency,
    currBegBalance AS beginning_balance_currency,
    currEndingBalance AS ending_balance_currency,

    SAFE_CAST(lastModifiedDateTime AS TIMESTAMP) AS last_modified_at
  FROM ${ref("dw_1_bronze_visma", "visma_general_ledger_transactions")}
  WHERE isDeleted IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
),

enriched AS (
  SELECT
    b.*,
    cdp.project_id,
    sd.segment2_value AS source_segment_2_value,
    sd.department_code AS department_code,
    bm.business_unit_id AS mapped_business_unit_id,
    bm.business_unit_name AS mapped_business_unit_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY b.tenant_id, b.batch_number, b.ref_number, b.line_number
      ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN bm.source_segment_2_value IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC,
        bm.valid_from DESC
    ) AS bu_match_rank
  FROM base AS b
  LEFT JOIN customer_document_project_map AS cdp
    ON b.module = 'AR'
   AND b.tenant_id = cdp.tenant_id
   AND b.ref_number = cdp.ref_number
  LEFT JOIN subaccount_dim AS sd
    ON b.tenant_id = sd.tenant_id
   AND (b.subaccount_id = sd.subaccount_id OR b.subaccount_id = sd.subaccount_number)
  LEFT JOIN business_unit_mapping AS bm
    ON b.tenant_id = bm.tenant_id
   AND b.transaction_date BETWEEN bm.valid_from AND bm.valid_to
   AND (
     bm.source_segment_2_value IS NULL
     OR bm.source_segment_2_value = COALESCE(sd.segment2_value, '0')
   )
)

SELECT
  tenant_id,
  synced_at,
  organization_name,
  COALESCE(mapped_business_unit_id, CONCAT(tenant_id, '|UNMAPPED')) AS business_unit_id,
  COALESCE(mapped_business_unit_name, organization_name) AS business_unit_name,

  batch_number,
  ref_number,
  line_number,

  account_cd,
  account_cd AS account_id,
  account_type,
  subaccount_id,
  branch_id,
  ledger,
  currency_id,
  module,

  -- Department link: resolved via subaccount join (tenant_id + subaccount_id);
  -- department_code = dim_subaccount.segment3. department_key is computed with
  -- the SAME FARM_FINGERPRINT formula as dim_department, so it joins 1:1 to it.
  department_code AS department_id,
  CASE
    WHEN department_code IS NOT NULL THEN
      FARM_FINGERPRINT(CONCAT(
        CAST(tenant_id AS STRING), '|',
        CAST(department_code AS STRING)
      ))
    ELSE NULL
  END AS department_key,

  transaction_date,
  financial_period,
  description,
  project_id,

  debit_amount,
  credit_amount,
  beginning_balance,
  ending_balance,

  debit_amount_currency,
  credit_amount_currency,
  beginning_balance_currency,
  ending_balance_currency,

  last_modified_at
FROM enriched
WHERE bu_match_rank = 1

compiled_main.select_query:
WITH subaccount_dim AS (
  SELECT
    tenant_id,
    subaccount_id,
    subaccount_number,
    segment2 AS segment2_value,
    segment3 AS department_code
  FROM `prj-dw-dev.dw_1_silver_visma.dim_subaccount`
),

business_unit_mapping AS (
  SELECT
    tenant_id,
    source_segment_2_value,
    business_unit_id,
    business_unit_name,
    valid_from,
    COALESCE(valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31') AS valid_to
  FROM `prj-dw-dev.dw_1_silver_excel.business_unit_mapping`
),

customer_document_project_map AS (
  SELECT
    tenantId AS tenant_id,
    referenceNumber AS ref_number,
    ANY_VALUE(NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(JSON_VALUE(project, '$.id')), ''), 'X')) AS project_id
  FROM `prj-dw-dev.dw_1_bronze_visma.visma_customer_documents`
  WHERE isDeleted IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
    AND NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(JSON_VALUE(project, '$.id')), ''), 'X') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(JSON_VALUE(project, '$.id')), ''), 'X')) = 1
),

supplier_invoice_project_map_line AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tenant_id,
    reference_number AS ref_number,
    CAST(line_number AS STRING) AS line_number,
    project_id
  FROM `prj-dw-dev.dw_1_silver_visma.fact_supplier_invoice_line`
  WHERE project_id IS NOT NULL
),

supplier_invoice_project_map_line_unique AS (
  SELECT
    tenant_id,
    ref_number,
    line_number,
    project_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      tenant_id,
      ref_number,
      line_number,
      project_id,
      MIN(project_id) OVER (
        PARTITION BY tenant_id, ref_number, line_number
      ) AS min_project_id,
      MAX(project_id) OVER (
        PARTITION BY tenant_id, ref_number, line_number
      ) AS max_project_id,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY tenant_id, ref_number, line_number
        ORDER BY project_id
      ) AS row_num
    FROM supplier_invoice_project_map_line
  )
  WHERE row_num = 1
    AND min_project_id = max_project_id
),

supplier_invoice_project_map_doc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tenant_id,
    reference_number AS ref_number,
    project_id
  FROM `prj-dw-dev.dw_1_silver_visma.fact_supplier_invoice_line`
  WHERE project_id IS NOT NULL
),

supplier_invoice_project_map_doc_unique AS (
  SELECT
    tenant_id,
    ref_number,
    project_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      tenant_id,
      ref_number,
      project_id,
      MIN(project_id) OVER (
        PARTITION BY tenant_id, ref_number
      ) AS min_project_id,
      MAX(project_id) OVER (
        PARTITION BY tenant_id, ref_number
      ) AS max_project_id,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY tenant_id, ref_number
        ORDER BY project_id
      ) AS row_num
    FROM supplier_invoice_project_map_doc
  )
  WHERE row_num = 1
    AND min_project_id = max_project_id
),

-- PM (project-module) GL rows carry NO project on the GL record itself; the
-- project lives on the matching projecttransaction line. Map GL batch → project
-- via the fact_project_transaction_line silver model, keeping only batches that
-- resolve to exactly ONE project (same uniqueness guard as the AR/AP maps above)
-- so a multi-project batch never fans out or gets mis-attributed. NB: this map is
-- empty until the project_transactions backfill lands ModulePM rows in bronze —
-- before then PM rows simply keep project_id = NULL (no regression).
-- module encoding differs by source: GL fact uses 'PM', project lines use 'ModulePM'.
project_transaction_pm_map AS (
  SELECT
    tenant_id,
    batch_number,
    ANY_VALUE(line_project_id) AS project_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      tenant_id,
      batch_number,
      project_id AS line_project_id
    FROM `prj-dw-dev.dw_1_silver_visma.fact_project_transaction_line`
    WHERE module = 'ModulePM'
      AND project_id IS NOT NULL
      AND batch_number IS NOT NULL
  )
  GROUP BY tenant_id, batch_number
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT line_project_id) = 1
),

-- PRIMARY PM source: the journal LINE carries the project directly
-- (journalTransactionLines[].project.id), so this resolves PM project linkage at
-- the exact GL line grain — recovering BOTH the multi-project batches that the
-- batch-level project_transaction_pm_map above must drop (COUNT(DISTINCT)=1), AND
-- the batches that never produced a projecttransaction doc at all. GL line_number
-- aligns 1:1 with journalTransactionLines[].lineNumber (verified), and project.id
-- shares the warehouse project_id format (e.g. 'AS10278'). 'X' / '' = no project
-- (contra/clearing lines). NB: empty until the journal_transactions backfill lands
-- ModulePM rows in bronze — before then PM rows fall back to the projecttransaction
-- map, then NULL (no regression).
journal_pm_line_map AS (
  SELECT
    tenant_id,
    batch_number,
    line_number,
    ANY_VALUE(line_project_id) AS project_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      tenantId AS tenant_id,
      batchNumber AS batch_number,
      JSON_VALUE(ln, '$.lineNumber') AS line_number,
      NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(JSON_VALUE(ln, '$.project.id')), ''), 'X') AS line_project_id
    FROM `prj-dw-dev.dw_1_bronze_visma.visma_journal_transactions`,
         UNNEST(JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(journalTransactionLines)) AS ln
    WHERE isDeleted IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
      AND module = 'ModulePM'
  )
  WHERE line_project_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY tenant_id, batch_number, line_number
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT line_project_id) = 1
),

base AS (
  SELECT
    tenantId AS tenant_id,
    syncedAt AS synced_at,
    organizationName AS organization_name,

    batchNumber AS batch_number,
    refNumber AS ref_number,
    CAST(lineNumber AS STRING) AS line_number,

    COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(account, '$.number'), CAST(account AS STRING)) AS account_cd,
    JSON_VALUE(account, '$.type') AS account_type,
    subaccount AS subaccount_id,
    COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(branch, '$.number'), CAST(branch AS STRING)) AS branch_id,
    COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(ledger, '$.id'), CAST(ledger AS STRING)) AS ledger,
    currency AS currency_id,
    module,

    COALESCE(
      DATE(SAFE_CAST(tranDate AS DATETIME)),
      DATE(SAFE_CAST(tranDate AS TIMESTAMP)),
      SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', period)
    ) AS transaction_date,
    period AS financial_period,

    description,

    debitAmount AS debit_amount,
    creditAmount AS credit_amount,
    begBalance AS beginning_balance,
    endingBalance AS ending_balance,

    currDebitAmount AS debit_amount_currency,
    currCreditAmount AS credit_amount_currency,
    currBegBalance AS beginning_balance_currency,
    currEndingBalance AS ending_balance_currency,

    SAFE_CAST(lastModifiedDateTime AS TIMESTAMP) AS last_modified_at
  FROM `prj-dw-dev.dw_1_bronze_visma.visma_general_ledger_transactions`
  WHERE isDeleted IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
),

enriched AS (
  SELECT
    b.*,
    CASE
      WHEN b.module = 'AR' THEN cdp.project_id
      WHEN b.module = 'AP' THEN COALESCE(sipl.project_id, sipd.project_id)
      WHEN b.module = 'PM' THEN COALESCE(jlm.project_id, ptm.project_id)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS project_id,
    sd.segment2_value AS source_segment_2_value,
    sd.department_code AS department_code,
    bm.business_unit_id AS mapped_business_unit_id,
    bm.business_unit_name AS mapped_business_unit_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY b.tenant_id, b.batch_number, b.ref_number, b.line_number
      ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN bm.source_segment_2_value IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC,
        bm.valid_from DESC
    ) AS bu_match_rank
  FROM base AS b
  LEFT JOIN customer_document_project_map AS cdp
    ON b.module = 'AR'
   AND b.tenant_id = cdp.tenant_id
   AND b.ref_number = cdp.ref_number
  LEFT JOIN supplier_invoice_project_map_line_unique AS sipl
    ON b.module = 'AP'
   AND b.tenant_id = sipl.tenant_id
   AND b.ref_number = sipl.ref_number
   AND b.line_number = sipl.line_number
  LEFT JOIN supplier_invoice_project_map_doc_unique AS sipd
    ON b.module = 'AP'
   AND b.tenant_id = sipd.tenant_id
   AND b.ref_number = sipd.ref_number
  LEFT JOIN journal_pm_line_map AS jlm
    ON b.module = 'PM'
   AND b.tenant_id = jlm.tenant_id
   AND b.batch_number = jlm.batch_number
   AND b.line_number = jlm.line_number
  LEFT JOIN project_transaction_pm_map AS ptm
    ON b.module = 'PM'
   AND b.tenant_id = ptm.tenant_id
   AND b.batch_number = ptm.batch_number
  LEFT JOIN subaccount_dim AS sd
    ON b.tenant_id = sd.tenant_id
   AND (b.subaccount_id = sd.subaccount_id OR b.subaccount_id = sd.subaccount_number)
  LEFT JOIN business_unit_mapping AS bm
    ON b.tenant_id = bm.tenant_id
   AND b.transaction_date BETWEEN bm.valid_from AND bm.valid_to
   AND (
     bm.source_segment_2_value IS NULL
     OR bm.source_segment_2_value = COALESCE(sd.segment2_value, '0')
   )
)

SELECT
  tenant_id,
  synced_at,
  organization_name,
  COALESCE(mapped_business_unit_id, CONCAT(tenant_id, '|UNMAPPED')) AS business_unit_id,
  COALESCE(mapped_business_unit_name, organization_name) AS business_unit_name,

  batch_number,
  ref_number,
  line_number,

  account_cd,
  account_cd AS account_id,
  account_type,
  subaccount_id,
  branch_id,
  ledger,
  currency_id,
  module,

  -- Department link: resolved via subaccount join (tenant_id + subaccount_id);
  -- department_code = dim_subaccount.segment3. department_key is computed with
  -- the SAME FARM_FINGERPRINT formula as dim_department, so it joins 1:1 to it.
  department_code AS department_id,
  CASE
    WHEN department_code IS NOT NULL THEN
      FARM_FINGERPRINT(CONCAT(
        CAST(tenant_id AS STRING), '|',
        CAST(department_code AS STRING)
      ))
    ELSE NULL
  END AS department_key,

  transaction_date,
  financial_period,
  description,
  project_id,

  debit_amount,
  credit_amount,
  beginning_balance,
  ending_balance,

  debit_amount_currency,
  credit_amount_currency,
  beginning_balance_currency,
  ending_balance_currency,

  last_modified_at
FROM enriched
WHERE bu_match_rank = 1

general_ledger_source_comparison.interpretation: Dev already has AR unique-document project linkage. Compiled main additionally has AP line/document and PM journal-line/batch linkage, with stronger AR blank/X normalisation. These are transformation sources, not business records.
